reviews.comment: Dr. San Pedro is THE BEST. She is so helpful during office hours and explains the material so well. She organizes her lectures well but if you don't understand something or you're struggling GO TO HER OFFICE HOURS!!! She is so helpful with the Aktiv and will sit there with you until you understand.
reviews.ratingTags: Gives good feedback--Test heavy--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Dr. San Pedro was extremely caring! She encourages her students to ask questions, study, and not get overwhelmed by the complexity of Organic Chemistry. Her expectation and grading criteria is very clear in her syllabus and lectures. She holds exam review sessions before each exam which was very beneficial! I highly recommend taking her!

She is a good teacher, you can tell she cares about ochem. She also gives so much homework omg. Anyways, if i could go back in time, I would enroll with a professor with more leniency, because ochem is a HARD class. She doesn't curve, and there's a plethora of profs who do. So take that as you will!
reviews.ratingTags: Amazing lectures --Lots of homework--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Dr. San Pedro is incredible at teaching and her exams are very fair, with extra credit points on every exam. Despite people saying that her lectures move too quickly, she actually works slower than most other profs. Also, she provides SO many practice problems to help prepare for exams. 1000/10 recommend!!!

Professor San Pedro was a good professor but if you struggle to keep up with a fast paced class then this is not the class for you. San Pedro talks very fast and has an expectation that you understand the concept as she covers it (at a fast pace this was hard) and it is definitely expected that you to read the textbook before and after each class.
She's a good teacher but she goes really fast in class. She is helpful in office hours. The exams are average but you need to study well in advance.

Dr. San Pedro does research, so you will have a lot more homework than other profs. Her exam reviews and past exams weren't even kind of like the actual exams and no extra credit is given like some of these reviews say. Also, she goes over content until the class before the exam, which makes things very hard in a class that is solely memorization.

I think this is the best professor to teach CHEM 228/258. Truly cares about YOU understanding the concepts and helps with ATKIV questions during office hours. Would 100% recommend prof to anyone. Exams were light compared to other profs by studying the review sheets, watching some of the pre recorded lectures, and atkiv hw.
reviews.ratingTags: Participation matters--Lots of homework--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: The BEST ochem prof. She explained the reactions so well and was interesting to listen to. Always has study sessions before the tests, has extra credit on every test (5-8 points), and makes the questions very doable. Very easy to get an A if you go to class and study a bit for tests. Wish i could take her again, so amazing!

San Pedro is a great Ochem 1 professor and really cares about her students. She is always working with you, and honestly has easy exams compared to other ochem professors. Really glad I got her as a professor, quizzes are hard but only takes 80% of the quiz questions for each quiz grade.

Dr. San Pedro is an incredible professor! She makes ochem manageable and easier. The T/TH sections only have 3 exams that are weighted heavily. A lot of outside practice/studying is required but she provides videos, reviews, past exams, and practice problems. There is a lot of Aktiv homework but it helps for the exams. I definitely recommend!
reviews.ratingTags: Lots of homework--Test heavy--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: I honestly worked so hard in this class just to end up with a C. Went to office hours and everything. The class is super challenging and I think if you are a person who has no prior experience with chem this professor is just NOT the right choice. She is a cool person to chat with outside of class, but is so unclear when it comes to exams.

For the entire semester, there was confusion regarding your grade on canvas vs. your actual grade in the class, & half the time she wouldn't finish covering all the slides before exams. She also does not drop lowest grades/round, etc, & her office hours were cancelled nearly every week. Overall ok prof, but I personally won't be taking her again.

Exams are much harder than the review materials and don't match what's emphasized in class. she doesn't curve grades at all 89 stays a B. even if you put in the effort, it's hard to get an A, I might end up with a C.The grading and exam difficulty make this class more frustrating than it needs to be. I wouldn't recommend taking her.

She made Ochem understandable! I was so thankful that I got her. She does do iclicker points for attending class, so go to class. HW + quizzes are rounded. She also has easy tests compared to other profs. She also includes bonus questions on exams so it is possible to get over 100. I had a 99 in the class going into the final. So sweet too!

Honestly getting a B was definitely on me, but I did not like San Pedro. She gave her MWF section 5 exams but her TTh section had 4 (including the final). I didn't appreciate the way she approached grades for her respective sections but overall the class isn't awful.

Dr. San Pedro is probably my favorite STEM prof. She has tons of extra material on canvas (I used this all the time). She moves fast wi/ lots of info, and 2 homeworks plus 1 quiz per chapter. It's not a super easy class but if you review before class, do your homework throughout the week and find a group, it is totally possible to get a good grade.

She is an amazing prof and makes sure that everything is taught well. She is very caring and shows passion for chemistry. 3 exams in total and 1 final and no exam is dropped. She doesn't seem to curve but its okay because you should be well for the class. AKTIV homework was okay but the quizzes was terrible but its not her fault.
Easy to understand he slides, explained things in detail. Also was worried about O-chem being so hard, but turns out to me that I loved Ochem, and she helped so much

i honestly loved having dr san pedro! ochem is just a fast-paced tough subject regardless of who you take, but she made it easy to understand. tests were way easier than the other profs in my opinion. not too much homework either
I took San Pedro for CHEM 257 and she is a great teacher. She made Ochem seem super simple in my opinion, and her grading wasn't too hard either.

TAKE HER FOR OCHEM!!!! She is the best professor for an ochem class. She truly make learning this material so much easier. If you pay attention in class you can do extremely well. She is amazing and is so helpful when you have questions for her.

She was the best OChem professor that I could have had and simplified the content to make a hard course more digestible. She did go through material quickly, but she was thorough in her explanations and make it easily understandable. Everyone is always scared of OChem going into it, but she made it interesting and easily approachable.

Dr. San Pedro is the best! Her lectures were cohesive and well-paced, and she made it very clear what you were expected to know. The tests were very fair and her exam reviews were very helpful. She is a very passionate teacher and tries to connect concepts to real-world examples. She truly cares about the students and I wish she taught ochem 2!

attendance is kinda mandatory because there are clicker questions for a grade, but her lectures are really good. the test review material is very helpful and there is extra credit on the exams :) she is very sweet and understanding too, definitely take her!

TAKE HER! She made Ochem so much simpler and her exams are very straight forward because she teaches so well. She gives extra credit opportunities and her office hours are the very helpful. She's kind and understanding, funny and well respected. She focuses on concepts and uses visual aid often. If she taught ochem 2 I would take her in a heartbeat

I cannot say enough good things about Dr. San Pedro. I had an especially difficult semester due to some personal issues and I was out a lot right before finals. It was very difficult to catch up, and I struggled. Dr. San Pedro was so understanding, and she went over & beyond to help me catch up. She truly cares about her students. Take her!!

San Pedro makes OCHEM as easy as it can be. There are many extra bonus points so that an A is easily attainable if you put in the effort. She is incredibly caring and her office hours are very helpful. Tests are very straightforward and there is ample review material. I cannot recommend San Pedro enough.

As far as ochem profs go, San Pedro is pretty solid. She truly wants you to succeed and makes a fourth of the class easy to get full points in. Each test has bonus point opportunities, so if you really want an A, you can get one. Ochem is hard but San Pedro makes it bearable and gives ample practice opportunities and review sessions.

I already like OChem, which made this course with San Pedro exceptionally easy with how good her lectures are. More importantly, her tests are great if you study (All I did was the extra practice homework questions). Want to pass OChem and not tear your hair out? Take her.

Dr. San Pedro is easily one of the best Ochem profs at TAMU. She genuinely cares so much about all her students and her lectures are so informative! She also gives so many practice materials - 2 past exams and a review session for every lecture exam throughout the semester. Her exams compared to other Ochem profs are actually pretty easy.
reviews.ratingTags: Amazing lectures --Clear grading criteria--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: Dr. San Pedro is an awesome professor and even better person. She genuinely cares about the success of each of her students and is very kind in the way that she treats people. Her lectures + homework/quizzes + practice exams are great tools to use to achieve success on exams. Cannot recommend her enough- one of the best experiences I've had at A&M.

Aside from the fast-paced lectures which are normal for Ochem, she was a great professor. Her exams were very close to what she taught and the Aktiv assignments helped! She was always very kind and willing to answer any questions you had. She taught 3D structures and visual concepts very well which was beyond helpful in this class.

I loved her! A great professor, cares highly about her students. Only downside, her tests are extremely difficult. She does publish her past exams and an overview of chapter questions- which is semi helpful.

One of the worst course experiences I have had at tamu. Test reviews were not helpful at all as she sped through and skipped key things. She did not curve even though the class average was well below failing for the final. Lectures were hard to keep up in as she went very VERY fast. She is a nice person, but I would not take her again!
reviews.ratingTags: Tough grader--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: She is an amazing teacher. She clearly explained everything and made ochem a really easy class. One of my favorite professors at A&M.

Dr. San Pedro is a very good professor. Your grade is based on 3 exams, iclicker, aktiv homework, and quizzes. iClicker, homework, annd quizzes only needs to be 80% correct to get all 80 points. Homework is 5 chances each question and is very similar to quizzes. There are review sessions before every exam.
reviews.ratingTags: Gives good feedback--Test heavy--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Take her, she's the best! She is super sweet in lecture and truly wants you to understand the material. She moves fast, but there is a lot to cover so it's understandable. She gives you access to old tests as well as practice exams, work through & study those! The actual exam is similar in terms of concepts. HW, quizzes, iclicker to boost grade.

She was a great prof she explained organic chemistry topics very well but did go through the material at a very fast pace. The homework and quizzes really help your grade which is awesome since she does not do much extra credit and does not curve. She was always super accessible and available to help explain topics when needed.

Ochem is definitely a hard class but San Pedro is amazing at teaching and can teach ochem to a rock. Her exams are very straight forwards and are along the lines of the practice exams and reviews. Overall, she is amazing and I would 10/10 take her again

Dr. San Pedro is the best!! Ochem is a challenging class but Dr. San Pedro's lectures are clear and straight to the point. She gives a lot of practice material necessary to succeed. Her exams were fair and gives extra credit. Be ready to put in the work outside the class to get the grade YOU want!! Wished she taught chem 238. TAKE HER!!!!!!!
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: TAKE HER! 3 exams weekly quizzes, weekly hw, and Iclicker. She gives extra credit for exams and she is so caring! I absolutely love her. Her lecture moves very fast pace but you have to truly understand the material to do well! Not an easy class but very doable! Do good on the exams in the beginning

I took her in the summer and the class was all over the place. Very unorganized. She goes very fast during lecture and skips around alot of stuff. You need ALOT of free time to study for this class. If you work or take other classes in the summer then save this for the fall. She curves and does extra credit but it does nothing for your grade.

I highly recommend not taking her. I got COVID the first week of class, and ended up losing points on the iclicker portion of the grade. I also met with her to go over one of my exams, and she said her grader was too lenient on a question. I walked out of the meeting with a lower exam grade. Again, I HIGHLY recommend not taking her class.

Ochem is hard to learn and to teach, but San Pedro teaches concepts and mechanisms very well. Has a tendency to speed through lectures sometimes as she talks fast. Practice exams are slightly harder than actual exams. Owl homework and REEF participation help buffer grades. Highly recommend San Pedro, as she is a great lecturer.

Dr. San Pedro is probably the second best OCHEM prof in the department, and if she were teaching OCHEM 2 I'd take her in a heartbeat. Her exams are tricky, but if you show clear work she gives partial credit. Try A+ to boost your grade a lot. Material starts easy and gradually gets tougher throughout the semester. Nonetheless, you should take her!
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Test heavy--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Dr. San Pedro not only understands OChem, but she can teach it and make it easier to understand. OChem is not easy and obviously requires some effort, but the homework is a reasonable amount and you just have to get above an 80 for full credit. Her practice questions are just like the exam and she holds review sessions! She also gives bonus points!

San Pedro is an amazing Ochem prof. Class is usually super hard but she explains everything well and doesn't overload you with work. She is pretty understanding and will listen to you if you have any questions or issues. Also has extra credit on exams which is very nice.

Overall, Dr. San Pedro is a good professor. She gives you many practice exams and problem sets for the exams. She also makes summary sheets and extra notes for many chapters, and I found them to be very useful. The only complaint I have is that she goes fast in lectures and the annotated slides are not posted after class. Not an easy A, but doable.
reviews.ratingTags: Lots of homework--Accessible outside class--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Dr. San Pedro gives you so many resources and practice problems that are very similar to the tests. Obviously ochem is hard but if you put in the work and pay attention in class you should be okay. She is very sweet, caring, and funny and loves to answer questions. She uses OWL for homework, i hated that. Take her though!

I love Dr. San Pedro so much! I took chem 227 with her over the summer, and she could not do enough to make sure we had the tools we needed to succeed. She was so kind and understanding, while also doing a great job teaching. Go to her office hours! She is super helpful and appreciates when you ask her questions.

I'm currently taking her and I could not have asked for a better professor. It requires some textbook reading in order to fully understand the concepts. Her practice exams are pretty spot on for what the real thing is going to cover. Definitely pay attention during lecture. If you zone out for even a minute, you'll be behind.
reviews.ratingTags: Gives good feedback--Beware of pop quizzes--Caring

reviews.comment: She is very nice and wants us to do well, but Ochem is a hard class regardless. The homework and quizzes add up to 18% of the grade and the rest comes only from the exams. She did not add a curve at the end of the course, and each exam could cost you a letter grade. There is a lot of material covered fast, and homework and quizzes due every week.
reviews.ratingTags: Lots of homework--Graded by few things--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Dr. San Pedro is the best ochem professor ever. I am truly depressed that she isn't teaching 228 next semester! She is so clear about what she expects you to know, & even more than that, the exams are 100% fair and never give you anything unexpected. Ochem will always be hard, but she holds reviews before tests and gives you everything to succeed!
reviews.ratingTags: Accessible outside class--Skip class? You won't pass.--Caring

reviews.comment: Dr. San Pedro is a very caring prof and she gives students every chance to succeed in what is a very hard class for freshman. The exams have bonus points but in order to do well you have to go to lecture and you have to do the homework. I would also recommend going to the review sessions before the exam.
reviews.ratingTags: Lots of homework--Skip class? You won't pass.--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Really really cares about the students. Tests and grades are very fair. Dr. San Pedro is easy to understand and follow. She also gives lots of review materials for tests which is nice. Ultimately I didn't work as hard as I should have to get an A but I would definitely take again.

I thought Prof Pedro was definitely one of the better chem 107 profs at TAMU. She really does care and wants all of her students to succeed. I think she's def the go to if you didn't take AP Chem in high school. Do the HW it really helps. The si sessions also help reinforce what you didn't understand during the lecture.
reviews.ratingTags: Gives good feedback--Skip class? You won't pass.--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS

reviews.comment: She's really enthusiastic and wants you to do well. I don't particularly enjoy chemistry(and neither did most of my class) but she gives clear lectures and works out problems, so if you follow along you will understand. She posts the lectures online as well, and doing the Cengage homework helps you study. She does have an accent but it is okay.
Awesome class, great lectures, encourages small amount of group work through clicker questions

I honestly did not have a clue what was going on in lecture but doing the homeworks helped a lot! She gives a review session before each exam but it doesn't really help. Chemistry sucks in general but San Pedro is one of the easier CHEM107 professors.

The subject material is what makes the course difficult but her lectures are pretty good and keep you engaged. You should still expect to put in a lot of study time into this course and and be prepared to go to tutoring, if you want the A. She is passionate. She genuinely cares about her students and she is very accessible. I would take her again.
reviews.ratingTags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Caring--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Tests are deceivingly difficult, but she is an amazing professor who cares about her students and chemistry. She helps out her students as much as she can, while being fair to everyone, but makes you work for good grades.

I really liked having Dr. San Pedro for organic chemistry. She was caring, and it was easy to ask her questions. Her lectures were engaging, and she clearly explained the material. O Chem is still a hard class, and you definitely have to study... but I would take it with her again.
reviews.ratingTags: Skip class? You won't pass.--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--TEST HEAVY

reviews.comment: Dr. San Pedro is such a gem!! She is very sweet and caring about how well you do in her class. Organic Chemistry is VERY hard class, so dont go in expecting it to be easy. This is my 2nd time to take ochem 1 and compared to the other prof (curved me down to a D), I definitely recommend San Pedro. Her tests were WAY easier and straight forward.
reviews.ratingTags: Skip class? You won't pass.--TEST HEAVY--Caring

reviews.comment: Unless ochem is your only difficult class this semester do not take her. She is very kind and accessible but you will need to put in more work outside of this class compared to some of the other ochem profs. GO TO SI (if available) and A+!!!!!

one of the best profs ive had. she cares about her students succeeding and for that reason is accessible and accomodating. her tests are pretty hard but her lectures and reviews help ALOT. go to A+ if you can, get the clicker and homework points and you should be sitting pretty. i hated ochem but San Pedro made me LOVE it-she's the reason i did wel

OChem is NOT easy, you must put in the work outside of class with ANY professor. Dr. San Pedro cares about her students and is helpful in office hours. She shows the reaction mechanisms in detail for all of the visual learners and posts everything online/in emails. SHE is the reason I did well in this class! Put in the work and you will do fine!!
reviews.ratingTags: Skip class? You won't pass.--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--Caring

reviews.comment: Dr. San Pedro is caring when you go to her office hours and can explain concepts very well in that setting. The tests are markedly more difficult than any daily work you will do in the class, so extra help is a must. Almost nothing from the reviews she gave appeared on the test and if it did it was made much more difficult. Definitely, go to class.
reviews.ratingTags: Tough Grader--Skip class? You won't pass.--TEST HEAVY

reviews.comment: No SI for her class which really sucks. She doesn't have set grades in her class as she bases it off of the class average which always changes so you don't really have a number to shoot for. She expects you to go home teach yourself and then come to class where she skims over the material. Tests are nothing like the practice tests. Don't recommend.
reviews.ratingTags: Skip class? You won't pass.--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--TEST HEAVY

reviews.comment: She's a new professor and lets face it, this is an extremely difficult course. I don't think she's the best option for an Ochem prof but she's not bad. Her test were crazy hard but you're never going to find an easy Ochem exam. She was super sweet and really cares which made the class less torturous. Good luck!

She's helpful if you go to office hours. Unfortunately her practice tests are nothing like the real thing. She's nice and caring for the most part but it would be nice to have practice tests like the test. She didn't have an SI this semester which sucked but hopefully since it's her first semester she'll get one soon.
reviews.ratingTags: Skip class? You won't pass.--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--TEST HEAVY
